name: 06_saving_money_60s
description: Saving money, about 60 seconds (brief's own example)

request.script: Saving money is not about earning more. It is about small habits that you repeat every day. Start by keeping coins in a glass jar on your desk. Cook at home a few nights a week instead of ordering food. Before you buy something, wait one day and ask if you really need it. Compare prices at different shops, and use a shopping list. Put a fixed amount into a savings account the moment your salary arrives. Watch the balance grow slowly, month after month. Value is not only money; it is the security and freedom that savings give your family. Trust the process, because wealth is earned slowly.
